model_provenance.source: Synthetic no-mutual-coupling control retaining only supplied RLGC diagonals

input_provenance.source: Original assumed straight solid round-wire cross-section; coordinates and constant material values are explicit

segments.response_order: frequency,wire,incident_port; unit incident power-wave amplitude sqrt(W)

provenance.source: Original synthetic interboard harness using SPIKE geometry-derived sampled RLGC
provenance.port_loading: Each single-ended port explicitly uses a real 50 ohm reference; non-excited ports receive that matched load
provenance.control: all interconductor RLGC entries set to zero

limitations: Common ideal reference node; no physical shield transfer, board copper or radiation solve.
Sampled RLGC without interpolation; sampled passivity is not broadband causality qualification.
Lumped contacts are explicit series R-L; loads are explicit parallel G-C.
Physical routes, twisting, insulation interfaces and proximity effects are not inferred.
